description: `filter_complex` containing `|` and `;` (ffmpeg's own filter-graph separators) must succeed -- the shell-metacharacter check `flags` gets does not apply to it. The companion `c-ffmpeg-unsafe-input`/`c-ffmpeg-unsafe-filter-complex` cases cover the two checks' own remaining metacharacters failing; this case's own name deliberately avoids 'divergence' (lane B's own term for a documented cof-vs-electricity output difference): both engines succeed here identically, it is only the two *checks* (flags vs filter_complex) that treat these characters differently.
